name: i dreamed about static again
source:
Do you want to be a prisoner of your dreams? Who are you pretending to be? Everything you do is just a farce. A puppet.

[From [url=https://yasy-jpng.itch.io/idasa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想成为梦想的囚徒吗？你假装是谁？你所做的一切都只是一场闹剧。一个木偶。

[来自[url=https://yasy-jpng.itch.io/idasa]Itch.io[/url]]
